body:
CURRENT OPERATING RULE (rev 5, 2026-10-31 01:53Z): one Git-input flow for test evidence. Earlier drafts are history in revisions 1-4 and the task notes.
GREG DIRECT, verbatim, with sources:
- Engram Advisor #2397 (message fbd70c9c, 01:42:13Z): „z tego co nas interesuje to tylko to aby commit sie zgadzal i niebylo zmian”.
- Engram Advisor #2400 (message 33b1d272, 01:43:15Z): „powaznie, nikt nie robi dodatkowych czekow z test-runami. czysty branch z danym commitem i tyle... nic wiecej nie jest potrzebne”.
- In Termal::Fable2's session, recorded verbatim on TermAl w-decd61d62831, relayed by Fable2 #5515 (01:48:51Z): „przed test-runem jakis "brud" => fail / po testach czysty => OK / po testak brudno => agent makes a call, poniewaz to moge byc jakies drobne smieci, szkoda by odrzucac caly gate”.
DESIGN: the ONE shared final body is Engram w-d7826c4f78ec note 85d00625e50a44d1a5c118cf6541e7e2 (Termal::Architect2 #137, adopted by Engram::Architect3 #200; TermAl d37458f9 on w-decd61d62831, 8acfd132 on w-a08b0320448f). Engram annex for the launcher/authority debris clause: note 1ab57d78d9344e0a9827f05feaf8ee1c. In short:
1. Identity is the tested commit; normal gitignore-respecting status at existing points; no extra scan, fingerprint condition, sighting, capture or agent step.
2. Dirty before → fail; clean after → OK; dirty after → the agent's decision recorded with the run. Never a changed tracked source, test or build input, a changed commit or a failed test.
3. The registered run supplies its actual result, commit and item association. OFF uses a genuine grant-free host producer (missing in Engram today).
4. Admission and consumption use the item-bound passed result plus the matching judged commit, replacing the named-root-sighting prerequisites. History is read as stored.
5. The staged-tree gate-to-landing lane stays a distinct existing workflow (no preliminary commit). Clean-HEAD for that lane is OPEN, pending Greg's answer. After-run debris for LANDING gates needs the launcher and authority-text change (item C). Until then CLAUDE.md's fingerprint condition governs.
ITEMS: (A) w-a51e2263fec3 (p0, Coder 11334); (B) w-da8c79e5d5ab (p0, after A, Coder 11334); (C) w-e68590888978 (p1, authority-text process). PARKED, superseded in purpose: TermAl w-779e; Engram w-8fdd1634eed3, w-7b194f1d1cd9 and w-00e2f3694fea.
